items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Collect from Weenie Wagon, Popcorn Machine, or Cookie Jar at C.A.M.P.s

items.title: Build Anything in a Shelter
items.detail: Place any item in your shelter build menu

items.title: Collect a Teddy Bear
items.detail: Northeast of Knife Edge; toss grenade to knock them down from ledge

items.title: Kill a Creature while in a Team
items.detail: Join a team, then kill creatures like Scorched at Morgantown Airport

items.title: Kill a Human Enemy with a Power Tool Weapon
items.detail: Chainsaw spawns at Crimson Prospect or Metal Dome; Point Pleasant has Cultists

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Silver
items.detail: Buy silver jewelry and dinnerware from Helena in Aurum at Whitespring Mall

items.title: Use Photomode in your own C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Open Photomode and take a photo at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to vendors at train stations

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Five to eight gnomes at The General's Steakhouse walled garden in the Mire

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join or create a Daily Ops public team and enter the instance

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town bounty board in Burning Springs; eliminate assigned Outlaw

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for reliable robot spawns; use energy weapons

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from wild or plant at C.A.M.P.; Silva Homestead in Forest region

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume piece; Phantoms appear at cabins and fairgrounds; Organ Cave has boss

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Wavy Willard's Water Park in Toxic Valley has reliable spawns

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at Tinker's Workbench then scrap it

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn gold star on three separate days by completing six other dailies each day

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build a C.A.M.P. or Shelter inspired by slasher movies; submit entries for prizes including Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Night at the Morgue
events.description: Mini season event with SCORE ticket challenges focused on candy bowl interactions and costume-based activities.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Encounter Halloween-themed Scorched enemies wearing masks and costumes that drop mystery candy and legendary items.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn experience points at double rate during this weekend event.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this weekend event.
